title: General Asset Properties
description: Category-specific properties for general tangible assets: art, antiques, jewellery, collectibles, books, wine, clothing, firearms, musical instruments, property contents
$comment: This schema is composed with asset.json via allOf+if/then. Do NOT use additionalProperties:false here — it would reject core asset fields. Covers 12 category values.

stolenArtCheck.description: Result of a stolen art check against the Art Loss Register (ALR) or equivalent database. Required by auction houses before sale of art, antiques, and high-value collectibles

result.description: Outcome of the stolen art check

certificateReference.description: ALR certificate or search reference number

certificateUrl.description: URL to the ALR certificate or search result

checkedBy.description: Who performed the check — person name, organisation, or system identifier

gemologicalCertificate.description: Structured gemological certificate data from GIA, AGS, or other grading laboratory. Confirms stone identity, quality grades, and weight — essential for insurance and sale valuation

retrievedAt.description: When this certificate data was retrieved or verified

laboratory.description: The grading laboratory that issued the certificate

verificationUrl.description: URL to verify the certificate online with the issuing laboratory

colourGrade.description: Colour grade as assigned by the laboratory

clarityGrade.description: Clarity grade as assigned by the laboratory

cutGrade.description: Cut grade as assigned by the laboratory (diamonds only — not all labs grade cut for coloured stones)
